name: Amazon SES (AWS SDK v3)
solves: Provides the AWS SDK v3 client for Amazon Simple Email Service (`@aws-sdk/client-ses`) to send transactional and bulk email via the SES API, with configuration sets, templates, and IAM-authenticated access from Node.js.
best_for: High-volume transactional email on AWS where SES pricing and IAM auth matter
Lambda and serverless workers sending mail through `@aws-sdk/client-ses` or SES v2 APIs
Teams already operating in AWS that want email without a third-party ESP contract
Organizations needing configuration sets and bounce/complaint event publishing into SNS or Firehose
Cost-sensitive workloads past startup ESP free tiers
skip_when: You want React email templates and a modern ESP DX with minimal AWS setup (consider Resend)
You are not on AWS and do not want domain verification, IAM, and SES sandbox limits
You need a self-hosted SMTP relay with Nodemailer against your own MTA
You prefer Postmark or Mailgun's focused deliverability UX over the AWS console and raw SDK
Your stack is non-JavaScript and you would use a different SES language SDK
